 Here are the Cricket Predictions for the Women's Big Bash League 2026 - 21st Match - Hobart Hurricanes Women vs Brisbane Heat Women and 22nd Match - Perth Scorchers Women vs Adelaide Strikers Women, to be played on the 14th of November at the Bellerive Oval, Hobart and W.A.C.A Ground, Perth.
 Match Prediction - Hobart Hurricanes Women v Brisbane Heat Women 
 LIVE SCORES - 21st Match - Hobart Hurricanes Women vs Brisbane Heat Women (Bellerive Oval, Hobart) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at Bellerive Oval, Hobart (Women's Big Bash League) - 144
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Bellerive Oval, Hobart (Women's Big Bash League) - 132
 Current Form Hobart Hurricanes Women:
 Hobart Hurricanes Women are currently placed at the bottom most position on points table with 5 losses to their credit. They have 0 point to their name. Their NRR is -1.250.
 The top run scorer for Hobart Hurricanes Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Nicola Carey with 161 runs to her name.
 The top wicket taker for Hobart Hurricanes Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Heather Graham with 8 scalps under her belt .
 Hobart Hurricanes Women have lost their previous match against Adelaide Strikers Women by 4 wickets.
 Hobart Hurricanes Women batted first and they posted a total of 138 for 6 in 20 overs. Lizelle Lee, Chamari Athapaththu and Rachel Trenaman failed terribly. Chamari took 26 balls for her knock of 10 runs. Nicola Carey in the middle order played to her potential and scored 66 runs in 53 balls, stayed not out and helped Hobart Hurricanes Women get past the 130 run mark as they finished at 138 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Adelaide Strikers Women started off very well with openers Emma de Broughe and Maia Bouchier collecting 43 runs for the 1st wicket partnership. Bouchier made 26 runs while Broughe scored 41 runs. Laura Wolvaardt also contributed well with a run a ball 27. There were hiccups in the death overs for Adelaide Strikers Women and it all came down to 4 to win off the last ball. Sophie Ecclestone didn't disappoint. She hit a timely boundary and won the game for Adelaide Strikers Women on the last ball of the game with 4 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Brisbane Heat Women: 
 Brisbane Heat Women are currently placed at the 3rd position on points table with 3 wins and 2 losses to their credit. They have 6 points to their name. Their NRR is 0.092.
 The top run scorer for Brisbane Heat Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Charli Knott with 213 runs to her name.
 The top wicket taker for Brisbane Heat Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Lucy Hamilton with 6 scalps under her belt .
 Brisbane Heat Women have won their previous match against Melbourne Stars Women by 8 wickets.
 Melbourne Stars Women batted first and they posted a total of 165 for 5 in 20 overs. Meg Lanning and Amy Jones played really well at the top. Lanning made 52 off 45 balls while Jones went on to score 74 runs in only 52 deliveries. The rest of the batters failed to capitalise on the momentum that was formed and they had to settle for a total of 165, even though at one point, they were aiming at 180+.
 During the chase, Brisbane Heat Women lost the key wicket of Grace Harris quite early. However, after her dismissal, Georgia Redmayne and Orla Prendergast took the responsibility of taking Brisbane Heat Women home. Redmayne scored 74 runs off 50 balls while Prendergast smashed 52 off 36 deliveries. Both stayed not out and helped Brisbane Heat Women get over the line in the 19th over with 8 wickets in hand.
